content: We expect the effect of this to be similar to that of oversampling, in that it is likely to enable us to increase the recall of the minority class thus resulting in the decrease in recall of the overall model while maintaining high precision. We reiterate that this specific change to a model results in increasing the model's ability to better identify elements belonging to the minority class in dissimilar datasets when using BERT.
